title: FinEvo: Recursive Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Financial Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.28239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded their role in high-value productivity tasks, including financial analysis and modeling, while enabling models to play an increasingly active role in their own improvement. This motivates two complementary lines of inquiry: can financial modeling capabilities provide a foundation for model self-evolution, and can self-evolution, in turn, advance financial capabilities? We introduce FinEvo, a self-evolution framework that integrates autonomous experience construction with financial capability improvement. FinEvo prepares financial models, iteratively evolves challenges through self-play, and learns from the resulting interactions using executable rewards, relying on the same model throughout. translated_title: FinEvo：面向长期金融建模的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28239v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）的进步扩展了其在高价值生产力任务中的作用，包括金融分析和建模，同时使模型能够在自身改进中扮演越来越积极的角色。这引出了两个互补的研究方向：金融建模能力能否为模型自我进化提供基础？自我进化能否反过来推进金融能力？我们提出了FinEvo，一个将自主经验构建与金融能力提升相结合的自我进化框架。FinEvo准备金融模型，通过自我博弈迭代演化挑战，并使用可执行奖励从由此产生的交互中学习，全程依赖同一个模型。使用Qwen3.6-27B进行的端到端执行表明，求解反馈既支持不断增加的推理需求，又能识别可执行检查可能遗漏的规范问题。通过学习……（原文摘要至此不完整）
tldr: FinEvo提出了一个自我进化框架，通过自主经验构建、自我博弈迭代演化挑战以及可执行奖励学习，仅依靠单一模型即实现递归自我改进，从而提升长期金融建模能力。
en_tdlr: FinEvo is a self-evolution framework that achieves recursive self-improvement for long-horizon financial modeling by autonomously constructing experiences, iteratively evolving challenges through self-play, and learning via executable rewards, all with a single model.
